title: Service Levels of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty: Emergencies, Inspections, Repairs and Access
content:
The Homebuyer and Warranty Services desk applies these service levels to every Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage, each with the figures of the home's HomeCare program.

1. **Emergencies.** An item is an emergency only when its condition is listed in the program's emergency conditions. An emergency may be reported by telephone at any hour, and a technician is dispatched within the program's emergency response hours.
2. **Non-emergency items.** A non-emergency item must be reported in writing where the program requires written reports, and it is inspected within the program's inspection scheduling business days.
3. **Repairs.** An approved repair is completed within the program's repair target days, in calendar days of the approval.
4. **Access.** When Calloway asks to schedule an inspection or a repair, the homeowner has the program's access response days, in calendar days, to provide access. An item with no access offered in that time is closed and denied with reason "no access", and it may be reported again only as a new item.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Reported condition is on the program's emergency list | Emergency | Telephone report accepted at any hour; dispatch within the emergency response hours |
| Reported condition is not on the program's emergency list | Not an emergency | Written report where required; inspection within the scheduling business days |
| No access offered within the access response days after Calloway asked to schedule | Access not provided | Item closed and denied, no access; may come back only as a new item |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A report of no cooling under a program whose emergency list does not include no cooling is not an emergency; under a program whose list includes it, the report is an emergency and may be made by telephone at any hour.
